title: landing_shot_row_v1
description: One row per episode/shot logged by the env tracker. World frame: +x target line, +y LEFT of target, +z up, metres, m/s, degrees, rpm. Left-handed env rows must be converted to golfer frame (see docs/ENV_LANDING_LOGGING_SPEC.md). null = not measured (never 0, never NaN).

env.description: env class / xml name, e.g. humanoid_golf_v4_power

frame.description: golfer = LH rows mirrored so +y is left of the golfer's target line for both hands; world_raw = unmodified MuJoCo world (LH env is mirrored about x-z).

label.description: honest label, e.g. 'hypothetical power tier, env flight model, no roll, model-only'

face_yaw_deg.description: face normal azimuth in the x-y plane, + = left of target (open for LH golfer is +)

club_path_deg.description: club-head velocity azimuth, + = left (in-to-out for RH)

dynamic_loft_deg.description: face normal elevation above horizontal, deg (positive = lofted)

contact_dy_m.description: env._face_off[0], club-geom local y; toe/heel sign needs toe_sign

contact_dz_m.description: env._face_off[1], club-geom local z; + = above face centre

flight_time_s.description: first contact separation to first touchdown

y_m.description: lateral offset from target line, + = left

descent_angle_deg.description: angle below horizontal of velocity at first touchdown (positive number)

carry_m.description: ball x at first touchdown minus ball start x; 0.0 only if never landed (then landed=false)

total_m.description: env final ball x minus start x (no roll model in env => ~carry)

model_only.description: OPTIONAL outputs of post-hoc models, kept separate from measured env fields
